terms.definition: A species' role or job in its ecosystem.
terms.function: Describes how a species makes its living.
terms.whyItMatters: It explains how species share ecosystems.

terms.definition: Habitat is the address where a species lives; niche is the role it plays there.
terms.whyItMatters: Keeping them separate helps us describe a species fully.

terms.definition: The struggle when two species need the same niche resources.
terms.function: Usually forces species into different roles.
terms.whyItMatters: It shapes which species live where.
